primaryObjective: Make reporting delay a defensible, role-preserving, source-aware Analysis assessment without conflating occurrence, report, and posting dates.
hypothesis: Explicit occurrence and reported-or-posted date roles can be projected into non-negative delay intervals at sufficient MUFON and NUFORC coverage to make a previously unavailable assessment estimable.

inScope: immutable event-aligned reporting-delay sidecar with separate occurrence, reported, and posted date roles
typed non-negative day-delay projection with parse status, source, era, and macroregion
descriptive delay bins and source-era-region common-support comparison
compact Time-dashboard disclosure and JSON/CSV evidence export
deterministic provenance, release, preview, production, and rollback receipts
outOfScope: treating occurrence date as report or posting date
repairing missing dates from free text
coercing negative or ambiguous delays to zero
authenticity, incidence, behavioral, causal, or source-quality claims
any assessment other than reporting delay

requiredFields: reported date raw and parsed ordinal when present
posted date raw and parsed ordinal when present
estimators: source-era-region common-support standardized active/reference share difference
negativeControls: negative and ambiguous intervals remain excluded
readinessContract.uncertaintyTreatment: Reported and posted dates remain distinct. Reported date is preferred only when its explicit role is present; posted date is a separate fallback lane. Missing, ambiguous, negative, or precision-incompatible intervals fail closed.
readinessContract.suppressionPolicy: Show readiness instead of an inferential chart whenever typed coverage, date-role integrity, common support, bin support, or stability gates fail. Never treat missing delay as zero.

releaseGates: date-role separation, idempotence, and original-value preservation
statistical determinism, common support, FDR isolation, and holdout stability
no raw-count-driven inference and no Pattern Finder promotion in v1
Pages and R2 separation with immutable versioned R2 keys
desktop and mobile browser QA, keyboard, themes, reduced motion, exports, and zero console errors
identical frozen Pages package preview to production and tested rollback
stopConditions: fewer than 209065 rows remain typed without free-text date repair
fewer than two sources retain at least 1000 typed rows
reported and posted roles cannot remain distinct
the assessment requires a second browser event model
rights or provenance cannot be resolved
performance or existing Analysis behavior regresses beyond release gates
